findings.claim: Oscar 10-K 稱 ICHRA 將顛覆雇主團體保險並擴張個人保險市場；公司以 2025 年收購的 Lucie、IHC Specialty Benefits 作為 ICHRA 策略基礎（替代模式同時是公司自身的佈局）。
findings.excerpt: We continue to believe ICHRA will disrupt employer group coverage and expand individual insurance beyond the traditional ACA market. Our goal is to position Oscar as the preferred carrier for employees enrolling in health insurance through an ICHRA program.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：公司核心技術與基礎設施為自建，關鍵技術人員流失可能干擾營運；且未申請專利保護其專有技術。
findings.excerpt: we have registered, or applied to register, those trademarks that we believe are important to our business, but to date we have not filed patent applications to protect our innovations and proprietary technology.

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋未找到明確取代 Oscar 核心產品（ACA 個人健保）的新興技術來源；ICHRA 為政策／產品結構變動，非技術替代。搜尋結果的第三方摘要未讀原頁，未納入 finding。
